title: Light Blue Dye
summary: Single-use dye that gives compatible equipment a light blue palette.

fields.Use: Combine it with a compatible equipment item in inventory to recolour the item. The equipment keeps its stats.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by merchants including Dammon, Derryth Bonecloak, Quartermaster Talli and Zara.
fields.Base value: 3 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
